pages.mainText: / ABOUT USLeading the Future of SnackingAbout UsThroughout the day, all over the world, snacks bring people together.At Mondelēz International, we’re leading the future of snacking – with iconic brands including Oreo, Ritz, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; and CLIF snack bars. We also offer gum, candy, cheese, powdered beverages, and other local favorites in select markets.We bring consumers everyday moments of joy. From a quiet break of “me time” to an annual holiday feast, we’re proud to offer a wide range of snacking choices that play an important role in consumers’ daily lives.Rooted in local heritage and culinary traditions, our passionate team of 90,000 people is dedicated to bringing consumers new, culturally relevant snacking formats and flavors, while continuously improving upon beloved classics. We’re honored that our brands represent the “taste of the nation” in more than 150 countries around the world – and we’re constantly working to adapt them to stay a step ahead of changing consumer preferences.We’re investing in the future – finding innovative ways to source our ingredients more sustainably, make our packaging easier to recycle, and reduce our climate impact – while continuously delivering value for our many stakeholders.Put simply, we’re relentlessly committed to the millions of consumers around the world who enjoy our brands, and the joy it brings us to share them with you.Explore MoreWho We Are OUR WAY OF DOING BUSINESSOur Leadership AWARDSAdditional ResourcesMONDELĒZ INTERNATIONAL FACTSHEET
